verdict.rationale: Pilot is a done-for-you professional accounting, bookkeeping and tax service (per its llms.txt category, Professional Services), where human experts do the work. Customers do not author automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back user-built automations is outside this product type. The 'Custom workflows and reporting' line describes expert-delivered service, not a user automation builder with version control, so it does not make the axis apply.
